title: crataegus pruinosa var. magnifolia
intro: Crataegus pruinosa var. magnifolia, commonly known as the hawthorn tree, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used to promote cardiovascular health, lower blood pressure, and improve overall heart function. The bioactive constituents of Crataegus pruinosa var. magnifolia include flavonoids, oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of acting as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilator. Regular consumption of Crataegus pruinosa var. magnifolia is believed to have beneficial effects on cardiovascular health, and may help to reduce the risk of heart disease, improve exercise tolerance, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia.
